title: Foundations of Presence
description: Begin the course by establishing presence, resonance, and the first practices of attention.
longDescription: Part 1 introduces the container, practices, and core frameworks that support a living inquiry. It is designed to orient participants to sacred study through embodied presence and clarity.

title: Healing the Field
description: Deepen inner healing, relational awareness, and the alchemy of heart-based practice.
longDescription: Part 2 attends to healing, lineage, and the subtle field of experience so that presence can arise from a place of safety, care, and devotion.

title: Embodied Wisdom
description: Enter the embodied thread of wisdom through practice, dialogue, and creative exploration.
longDescription: Part 3 supports integration of insight into daily life, presence in action, and the cultivation of wisdom that is alive in the body.

title: Initiation of Knowing
description: Open into deep inquiry, initiation, and the unfolding of a more intimate relationship with truth.
longDescription: Part 4 offers a journey into direct knowing, initiation, and the subtle invitations that arise as the course matures.

title: Integration & Service
description: Bring the course into expression, service, and a grounded commitment to ongoing practice.
longDescription: Part 5 holds the integration of the 99 meetings and the opening of service, community, and the living expression of the teaching.
